title: The Most Important Part of Your LinkedIn Profile 🔎
description:
The “About” section on a LinkedIn profile is one of the most important parts to get correct. When a recruiter goes to your profile you can all be guarentee they will read it and it acts as a bit of a professional intoduction. Use this space to share how many years of experience you have, notable companies you’ve worked for, your top skills and a couple of career achievements as well. #linkedin #linkedintips #linkedinprofile #linkedinprofiletips
